description: Investigate and fix music module not working. Music module exists at src/modules/music-module/entry_point.ts and uses discord-player v7 with prefix commands (!bc play, !bc skip, etc.). Need to verify module loads, registers commands, and handles errors properly.
steps: 1. Read src/modules/music-module/entry_point.ts fully to understand architecture. Uses discord-player Player, prefix commands (PREFIX = '!bc'), Components V2 for now-playing cards.
2. Check if music module is enabled/loaded: search for music-module metadata.json to verify enabled:true. Check main bot index.ts or module loader for music module registration.
3. Verify discord-player dependencies in package.json: discord-player@^7.2.0, @discord-player/extractor@^7.2.0, ffmpeg-static@^5.3.0. All present - CONFIRMED.
4. Check if Player is initialized in music module constructor or initialize() method. discord-player v7 requires Player instance and extractors registration.
5. Common music module failure modes: (a) Player not initialized, (b) extractors not registered, (c) missing ffmpeg, (d) voice connection errors, (e) no error handling on prefix commands.

6. Add comprehensive error handling to music prefix command handler: wrap all play/skip/pause/etc handlers in try-catch, log errors to console with specific error type (voice channel not found, track not found, playback error, etc.).
7. Add V2 fallback error handling to nowPlaying card rendering - if V2 fails, fall back to simple text reply or EmbedBuilder with track title and duration.
8. Add startup verification in music module initialize() - check if Player initialized successfully, log warning if extractors fail to load.
9. Check for prefix command event listener registration - music module must listen to 'messageCreate' event and parse !bc commands. Verify this listener is registered.
10. Test music commands: !bc play [song], !bc queue, !bc skip. Check console logs for errors. Common errors: 'No voice channel', 'Track not found', 'Extractor error'.
acceptance_criteria: Music module loads successfully on bot startup, logs show '🎵 Music module initialized' or similar
!bc play [song name] command responds (either plays music or shows clear error message)
!bc queue command shows current queue or 'No songs in queue' message
!bc skip command skips to next song or shows 'Nothing playing' message
All music command errors are caught and logged with specific error details, not generic crashes
V2 now-playing cards have EmbedBuilder fallback if V2 fails
Console logs show clear errors when music commands fail: 'User not in voice channel', 'Track not found for query: [song]', 'Extractor failed: [extractor name]'
verification: Check console logs for 'Music module initialized' message
Join a voice channel in Discord test server
Send '!bc play never gonna give you up' in text channel
Verify bot responds with now-playing card or error message (not crash)
If plays: verify !bc skip, !bc pause, !bc queue commands work
If error: check console logs for specific error message, verify it's user-friendly
Leave voice channel, run !bc play again - should show 'Join a voice channel first' error
Test with invalid song: !bc play asdfqwerzxcv123 - should show 'No results found' or similar
